title: Fairness-aware Summarization for Justified Decision-Making
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on fairness in terms of race, ethnicity, and gender in text-based justifications for decisions.
models_tested: A custom multi-task neural model based on a sentence-ngram Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) and the Universal Sentence Encoder.
findings: The paper does not analyze or report any findings related to religion or faith.
